'''0.12d''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed various issues that occurred during player spawning.

==Changelog==
* Fixed a crash that occurs immediately before a character spawns
* Fixed a desync that occurs immediately before a character spawns
* Added handling of situations when the client begins to send INPUT in the future
* Server logs during a tick
* The last INPUT is lost before a desync
* Fixed an issue when determining video memory in launcher/installer
